interest: Tracks early 1930s Japanese labor unrest in transit, General Motors Japan, and Singer Sewing Machine Company, via periodic political reports.
overview: Docket for file 894.5045 (1930-1935) lists reports by Castle, Neville, Grew, and Garrels on transit strikes, Kanegafuchi Spinning, Sumitomo Steel, Japan Dyeing, Fukuoka coal miners, and disputes at General Motors Japan and Singer Sewing Machine Company.

people.name: Edwin L. Neville
people.role: Counselor of Embassy and Chargé d'Affaires ad interim

subfiles.about: A two-page Department of State list of papers indexing documents and cross-references regarding strikes and labor disputes in Japan between 1930 and 1935.
subfiles.summary: Indexes 1930-1935 reports on Tokyo and Kobe transit strikes, Kanegafuchi Spinning, Sumitomo Steel, Japan Dyeing, and Fukuoka coal mine disputes, plus foreign-firm conflicts at General Motors Japan (injuring an American and a Dane) and Singer Sewing Machine Company.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Strikes - Japan (File 894.5045)
